info.title: Baseline SWIFT Data Service
info.description: SR2026 prototype contract. BIC syntax follows ISO 9362; currency codes are supplied by the ISO 4217 Currency service. Licensed SwiftRef/RMA/SSI data remains a production prerequisite.

x-ui-resources.label: RMA Authorisation
x-ui-resources.description: 管理 BIC 對、FIN/FINPLUS、方向與訊息範圍；RMA 只代表通訊授權，不證明 SSI 或帳戶所有權。

fields.label: Own BIC (ISO 9362)
fields.description: Select a governed BIC from Bank Service.

fields.label: Counterparty BIC (ISO 9362)
fields.description: Select a governed BIC from Bank Service.

x-ui-resources.label: SSI
x-ui-resources.description: 管理可重用或單筆交易的 Settlement Instruction；Actual SWIFT Receiver BIC 在使用時必須通過對應的 RMA authorization。

fields.label: SSI Scope
fields.description: STANDING = reusable standing instruction; TRANSACTION_SPECIFIC requires a transaction binding before activation.

fields.label: Related RTGS / Clearing System
fields.description: Must reference one concrete active Clearing System Standing Data code; TARGET/TARGET2 are legacy aliases and new SSI must use T2.

fields.label: Scheme Type
fields.description: RTGS, LVPS, ACH or IPS; non-RTGS rails must not be labelled RTGS.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Lower numeric value has higher precedence within the same specificity and Route Class.

fields.label: Beneficiary Source
fields.description: SSI stores the Beneficiary BIC only when source is SSI. TRANSACTION means the value is supplied by transaction data and must not be stored in SSI.

fields.label: Beneficiary BIC (ISO 9362)
fields.description: Select the institution through Bank Service; the governed BIC is displayed. Bank Service does not provide an account.

x-ui-resources.label: Entities
x-ui-resources.description: 本行 Booking Branch / Entity Standing Data；不是 counterparty bank 或 country。

x-ui-resources.label: Nostro Account
x-ui-resources.description: 同一 Account Servicer 與幣別可配置多個遮罩帳號，以 purpose、priority、有效期解析；不得把 RMA 當帳戶所有權證據。

fields.label: Account Servicer BIC (ISO 9362)
fields.description: Select the Account Servicer from Bank Service.

The server derives counterpartyType=BANK from the selectable SR2026 Payment Message Index profile and rejects a client-supplied counterpartyType. MT/MX output format is deliberately absent because it is not a matching or ranking key.

post.description: Rechecks eligibility, Actual Receiver RMA and matching Nostro, then returns canonical roles plus immutable snapshot/token/hash. The caller owns full message assembly, transaction lifecycle and accounting.

409.description: Preview stale or route no longer eligible.

post.description: Returns only clearing systems referenced by currently Active and eligible SSI routes for the submitted MT2 payment-trigger transaction criteria, intersected with active Clearing System Standing Data. The selectable sourceMessageType is required; counterpartyType=BANK is server-derived and must not be supplied by the client. This is not the full capability catalogue.

parameters.name: settlementCountry
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market hint. Includes exact-market rails and governed PAN_REGIONAL rails whose eligibleCountries contain the requested country.

200.description: Active governed clearing-system standing data; TARGET/TARGET2 are legacy aliases for T2.

get.description: Returns the SR-governed outward MT3/MT4/MT7 catalogue with an explicit message-level SSI resolution scope marker and SSI-resolvable tag options.

200.description: Parameter-driven FIN Resolution catalogue; each message is marked SSI_RESOLVABLE or NO_SSI_RESOLVABLE_FIELDS.

post.description: Primary SR2026-governed, reference-only FIN field resolution for Treasury MT3 and Trade Finance MT4/MT7. No payment execution or confirmation semantics.

roleEvidence.description: Evidence and canonical settlement-route node identity for each role. Equal BICs are normalized only when canonicalRouteNodeId and ownerSide also match.

canonicalRouteNodeId.description: Identity derived from normalized BIC11, branch, account owner/servicer/identifier, currency, clearing context and instruction provenance; a BIC alone is insufficient.

200.description: Reference-only resolvedFields result; paymentExecutable is always false.

resolutionStatus.description: Runtime disposition for every audited field slot. Profile-excluded slots are returned explicitly as N_A rather than omitted.

reasonCode.description: Controlled reason such as ROUTE_COMPLETE or MESSAGE_PROFILE_EXCLUDED. A ROUTE_COMPLETE decision is attributed to ROUTE_RESOLVER/CANONICAL_ROUTE in provenance.

provenance.description: For NOT_REQUIRED route decisions, source is ROUTE_RESOLVER and ownerSide is CANONICAL_ROUTE; original candidate source/owner are retained separately when applicable.

400.description: Context, exact profile, option, or eligible SSI evidence is invalid/missing.

get.description: Reports configurable online-query, archive and archive-retention windows plus the most recent transactional lifecycle run across SSI, RMA, Nostro and booking-entity audit tables.

get.summary: Get one governed resolution page definition

MaintenanceIndexStatus.name: status
MaintenanceIndexStatus.description: Maintenance Index tab filter. ALL (and omission) returns ACTIVE plus SUPPRESSED records only; DRAFT, WIP, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REVOKED, SUPERSEDED, and historical versions are excluded.

ValidationError.description: SWIFT/ISO syntax or business-rule validation failed

companionValueFields.description: Hidden lookup-derived field bindings. These are not user inputs and the server remains authoritative at execute time.

PageParameterSelectedRouteIdentity.description: Exact indivisible SSI route selected from discovery. Every versioned component is revalidated before execution.

companionValues.description: Atomic hidden values belonging to the selected lookup record.

PageParameterEligibilitySnapshot.description: Opaque server-governed identity binding the displayed eligible choices to the subsequent resolve request.

PageParameterValidationScope.description: Governed NVR boundary. SSI-tag NVRs are resolved and evidenced by the SSI API; full-FIN NVRs remain a downstream responsibility and are not evaluated here.

PageParameterNvrOutcome.description: Canonical expected or actual NVR outcome.

PageParameterCompatibleNvrOutcome.description: Backward-compatible NVR outcome. N_A is accepted only for legacy page contracts.

PageParameterValidationDisposition.description: One governed validation responsibility. It does not select or change the scenario execution action or endpoint.

PageParameterScenarioValidation.description: Canonical dispositions plus legacy scalar fields retained for schema 1.0 readers.

validationScope.description: Required on newly emitted contracts; omitted only by legacy schema 1.0 data.

values.description: OAS-driven fieldId/value map. For Payment COV scenarios, the service derives 32A from governed typed date, currency and amount values, and merges server-governed 21, 119:COV, 121, Sequence B and controlled previous-message provenance from the selected scenario; clients must not invent or override them.

ResolutionPageSwiftMtCompatibilityView.description: MT compatibility or SSI evidence view. This document is not a complete FIN payment message.

ResolutionPageGeneratedOutput.description: A server-generated evidence representation of one canonical SSI resolution. Clients render the document and must not translate between formats.

ResolutionPageSettlementRoute.description: The bank-controlled atomic SSI settlement route selected by resolution; it never represents customer payment instructions.

outputs.description: Server-generated output representations from the same canonical resolution. Payment MT2/pacs.009 success returns SWIFT_MT and ISO_20022; clients do not convert them.

Bic.description: ISO 9362 BIC syntax only; directory existence requires licensed Bank/SwiftRef data.

Currency.description: Must also exist in Currency service ISO 4217 data.

legacyAliases.description: Accepted only for migration/reference; current UI displays the canonical code.

CurrentStatus.description: Server-derived maintenance status. EMPTY means no open child; IN_PROGRESS means an active WIP reservation; DRAFTED means an ordinary open DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED child; SUPPRESSED means an open SUPPRESSION child.

settlementCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 settlement-market country; distinct from counterparty/correspondent country.

clearingSystem.description: Concrete active standing-data code for the related RTGS or clearing scheme.

schemeType.description: Governed classification: RTGS, other large-value payment system, ACH, or instant payment scheme.

redirectDomain.description: Owning MT2 resolution domain when the caller must redirect; null on a terminal decision.

Mt2BankResolutionRequest.description: The service resolves the read-only BIC from the Bank Service identity; callers must not submit a BIC.

BankServiceId.description: Stable Bank Service identity. Its BIC is resolved server-side and is read-only output metadata.
